steps.label: submit-button-and-tab-text
steps.expr: (() => { const sub = document.querySelector('button[type=submit]'); const tabs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).map(b=>b.textContent.trim()).filter(t=>/Sign in|Create account/.test(t)); return { submitText: sub ? sub.textContent.trim() : null, tabs, submitRect: sub ? {top: Math.round(sub.getBoundingClientRect().top), bottom: Math.round(sub.getBoundingClientRect().bottom)} : null, innerHeight: window.innerHeight, scrollY: Math.round(window.scrollY) }; })()
